leadText:
Tony (Japanese: トニー Tony) is a character of the day who appeared in Go, Go Gogoat!.

Tony went to Alexa's Gogoat after it became distant from and , since they didn't know much about it at the time. Tony took it with him on a journey in order to see his father on the other side of the island. The group found out that Gogoat was gone and Tony's mother, along with an Officer Jenny, asked the group about his whereabouts. The group went off to search for both Tony and Gogoat.

When Alexa and Ash found them, Tony had Gogoat run off with him, since he was shy around them. However, Alexa comforted him and he explained about the drawing of a that he wanted to deliver to his father. As a group of attacked them, Tony, Alexa, and Ash rode on Gogoat, away from them until they encountered an unstable bridge. With the help of Gogoat and , the three crossed the substitute bridge and Tony got to see his father. In the nighttime, the family reunited with each other as they watched the of a Braviary in the night sky.
